e3a67becc98c3d4a.column_purpose: Primary key; term code in the form YYYYTT (e.g. 1995FA = Fall 1995, JA = January/IAP term, SP = Spring, SU = Summer). Identical in value to TERM_CODE.

ec2847a810954dd6.column_purpose: Calendar year in which the academic year ends (e.g. 2010 for Academic Year 2009-2010). Four terms share each value.

80ab96774a86f61b.column_purpose: Human-readable academic year label, e.g. 'Academic Year 2009-2010'.

c4a067b113c125c4.semantic_column_name: Last date to add a subject
c4a067b113c125c4.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) by which a subject may be added for the term; null for January and Summer terms (50% null).

ac5dd165b5081f81.column_purpose: Year in which degrees conferred for this term count; for Fall/Spring/January it equals the academic year, for Summer it is the following year (e.g. 2023SU -> 2024). Null for some terms.

b74da903be231a2c.semantic_column_name: Last date to drop a subject
b74da903be231a2c.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) by which a subject may be dropped without penalty; null for January and Summer terms.

662b9cb6930f4b03.column_purpose: Financial-aid award year the term belongs to; matches DEGREE_YEAR in the samples (Summer term maps to the following year). Null for some terms.

75191383f6f4420d.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the first class day of the term; null for some terms (e.g. older January terms).

100a0eec2986ab8a.column_purpose: End date of the graduate student award/stipend period covering the term (e.g. 31-AUG for summer, 15-JAN for fall). Null for many terms.

9c626aa51bd27120.column_purpose: Start date of the graduate student award/stipend period covering the term (e.g. 01-JUN, 01-SEP, 16-JAN). Null for many terms.

1782afd9bc3f38cb.column_purpose: Y/N flag; exactly one row is 'Y', marking the currently active term.

e0702ee17dbbc559.column_purpose: Y/N flag; 'Y' for the regular Fall and Spring terms (72 rows), 'N' for January and Summer terms (72 rows).

b888c4f97e59b2b7.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last class day of the term; null for some terms.

3a8d15ee1bbb7758.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last final exam day; populated for all 144 terms.

417b0f4c6875a036.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) on which pre-registration opens for the term (e.g. 01-MAY for fall, early December for spring).

c97cd5458d57b367.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) of (official) registration day for the term; populated for all terms.

d6161653c3243afd.column_purpose: Term code YYYYTT (FA/JA/SP/SU), same value as ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY; the join key referenced by most other tables (SUBJECT_OFFERED, TIME_MONTH, etc.).

c62b40101599e9fa.column_purpose: Human-readable term name, e.g. 'January Term 2009-2010', 'Summer Term 2023'.

8797b8adcebcd59f.column_purpose: Official end date of the term (DD-MON-YY), typically the last final-exam day.

3b369dc956c9f2fd.column_purpose: Concatenation of term code and description, e.g. '2010JA-January Term 2009-2010'; used as a display/join selector (one-to-one with ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL).

88e1500d70dddf41.column_purpose: Official start date of the term (DD-MON-YY).

aabeca9d660d220a.column_purpose: Relative status of the term: 'Previous' (past), 'Current' (active), 'Future' (upcoming), or 'Unspecified' (likely far-future terms not yet scheduled).

01412d54117365ba.column_purpose: Single-letter code for TERM_STATUS: C = Current, P = Previous, F = Future; null where status is 'Unspecified'.

bc7e4227b3a43ea9.column_purpose: ETL load date of the row into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows (full snapshot load).

0fa5b9f4173f3186.column_purpose: Same value as TERM_CODE (e.g. 1953FA, 2016SU): 4-digit year + FA/SP/SU term suffix. Duplicate of the primary key.

30f2d4e5853f0f6e.column_purpose: Calendar year in which the academic year begins; e.g. 1953FA belongs to academic year 1953 (i.e. 1952-1953). Ranges 1951-2030.

5d6750ad6eb6ccac.column_purpose: Human-readable academic year label, e.g. 'Academic Year 1952-1953'.

ced43c578dd7ea6a.column_purpose: Year used for degree/conferral accounting for the term; typically the spring/summer year of the academic year (e.g. 2016SU -> 2017). 'XXXX' (17 rows, mostly older terms) means not applicable/unknown. Alternative reading: it could instead be the graduation class year label rather than a conferral accounting year.

da48a8ff9fb3db45.column_purpose: Year used for financial-aid reporting for the term; same values as DEGREE_YEAR (e.g. 2016SU -> 2017), 'XXXX' for older terms. Alternative reading: it could be the start year of the financial-aid award period rather than a reporting year.

f63de801a0ae0849.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the first day of classes for the term; null for older terms (16% null).

35a3afc9986f5f84.column_purpose: End date of the graduate award/fellowship appointment period covering the term (e.g. 31-AUG-16 for Summer 2016); null for ~52% of terms (mostly older and spring/fall terms). Alternative reading: it could be the end of the term's graduate-stipend eligibility window rather than an award appointment period.

dc087fecc64d69ca.column_purpose: Start date of the graduate award/fellowship appointment period covering the term (e.g. 01-JUN-16 for Summer 2016); null for ~52% of terms. Alternative reading: it could be the start of the term's graduate-stipend eligibility window rather than an award appointment period.

f3bdea0ce3fa4cbb.column_purpose: Y/N flag marking the one term currently in progress; exactly one row is 'Y'.

3c85fd0d3e7360bb.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last day of classes for the term; null for older terms.

49b918657536f285.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last final exam of the term; equals or slightly follows TERM_END_DATE.

8201235727d8141d.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) on which pre-registration opens for the term (e.g. 02-MAY-16 for Summer 2016); null for ~39% of terms.

8cde8f7edd51678c.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) of registration day for the term; equals TERM_START_DATE in sampled rows.

8db0040be81811ba.column_purpose: Primary key: 4-digit year + FA/SP/SU suffix (e.g. 1953FA, 2016SU). Referenced by many subject/course/student tables.

60a98d36ad604a96.column_purpose: Human-readable term name, e.g. 'Fall Term 1952-1953', 'Summer Term 2016'.

3ec342e438fdd35e.column_purpose: Official end date (DD-MON-YY) of the term, typically the last final-exam day.

b575318276758bfd.column_purpose: Concatenation of TERM_CODE and TERM_DESCRIPTION (e.g. '1953FA-Fall Term 1952-1953'), used as a display selector; joins one-to-one to ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_SELECTOR.

37e961ebbb374bd6.column_purpose: Official start date (DD-MON-YY) of the term.

262853201cd190c5.column_purpose: Single-letter code for the term type/period, joined to ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_INDICATOR: P = Summer Term, C = Fall Term, F = January (IAP) Term. 'P' dominates because summer terms are most numerous.

78fe8951e4c1d379.column_purpose: ETL load date of the row into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows (full snapshot load).

ffa00a9f2ba69b3e.column_purpose: Y/N flag indicating whether this row's term is the current academic term (Y for the SIS_CURRENT_TERM row, N otherwise).

162bf1bb9038a55b.column_purpose: Academic term code in YYYY+session format (e.g., 2025FA = Fall 2025, 2024SU = Summer 2024, 2025JA = January/IAP 2025). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE.

2a707c2c95937b0b.column_purpose: Human-readable name of the term, e.g., 'Fall Term 2024-2025', 'January Term 2024-2025', 'Summer Term 2024'.

ac7e68319808e86e.column_purpose: Last day of the term, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g., 20-DEC-24).

7293779beed23b59.column_purpose: Single-letter code for the term's role: C = current term, P = previous term, F = future/upcoming term. Referenced by ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR and ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR.

9b79b41fda99c598.column_purpose: Last calendar day belonging to this term before the next term begins, DD-MON-YY format (e.g., 05-JAN-25 for the fall term, the day before the January term starts on 06-JAN-25).

fcbb4157c1f5e121.column_purpose: SIS parameter name identifying the term's role: SIS_CURRENT_TERM, SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM, or SIS_UPCOMING_TERM.

bb6f9bd16d0f89c9.column_purpose: First day of the term, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g., 03-SEP-24).

f0be170f1d023f96.column_purpose: Total assignable (usable/occupiable) floor area of the building in square feet. Always less than or equal to gross square footage; 0 for some buildings.

24076466b5ad5179.column_purpose: Total gross floor area of the building in square feet, including non-assignable space (walls, corridors, mechanical).

ef992b170bc98d87.column_purpose: Constant value 1 on every row; likely a dummy counter used for row-count aggregation in reporting (e.g., summing to count buildings). Alternative reading: a sequence/ordinal with no analytical meaning.

4f5a2efa9f2b8457.column_purpose: Primary key identifying the building; matches the building number (e.g. 'W79', 'E52', 'NE47'). Referenced by FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS, FAC_FLOOR, and FAC_ROOMS.

fa6a0fa1d3ea55d6.column_purpose: Mailing (postal) address of the building, as distinct from its street address; the facilities address tables (FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS / FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS) track street, mailing, E911, and parcel addresses per building, suggesting this is the mailing-purpose address. Alternative reading: a free-form address string that may duplicate the street address.

9d3bac6cdc412583.column_purpose: Official building name (e.g. 'Simmons Hall', 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'); some rows use generic labels like 'Building 41'. A few names repeat (e.g. Wallace Astrophysical Observatory, 6 rows), likely multiple structures sharing a name.

db593b80e91a7716.column_purpose: MIT building number/code (e.g. 'W79', 'E52', 'OC19Q'), identical to BUILDING_KEY on these rows; used as the join key to FAC_BUILDING/FCLT_BUILDING and as parent building number in those tables.

619e1c89b08dc16e.column_purpose: Street address of the building (e.g. '229 VASSAR ST', '50 MEMORIAL DR'); multiple buildings can share an address.

5aeb7dfb1d6cb042.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows, indicating a full snapshot load on December 19, 2024.

4515a67acf425266.column_purpose: First two digits of the CIP code: the broad instructional category (e.g. 16 = Foreign Languages, 22 = Legal Professions, 43 = Homeland Security/Law Enforcement). The detected join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is a spurious numeric coincidence — space-usage labels (e.g. 'CLNT MEETING ROOM') are unrelated to CIP categories and should be ignored.

0930536fc0055034.column_purpose: Title of the 2-digit CIP category (e.g. 'FOREIGN LANGUAGES AND LITERATURES', 'LEGAL PROFESSIONS AND STUDIES'). More distinct values (87) than category codes (52) because titles vary across CIP versions (e.g. 'HEALTH PROFESSIONS AND RELATED PROGRAMS' vs. 'HEALTH PROFESSIONS RESIDENCY/FELLOWSHIP PROGRAMS').

3b0d36a64bdda4a1.column_purpose: Middle two digits of the CIP code combined with the category, forming the 4-digit intermediate grouping (e.g. 1612, 2202, 4301). Not unique because codes repeat across CIP versions.

3c580b9984c77dee.column_purpose: Title of the 4-digit CIP intermediate grouping (e.g. 'Classical and Ancient Near Eastern Languages and Literatures', 'Criminal Justice and Corrections').

33cbdc043d577e1a.column_purpose: Notes describing changes between CIP revisions: whether a code is new in a given year, had no substantive changes, or was moved from/to another code (e.g. 'Moved from 51.2931', 'New in 2020'). Null for codes with no recorded change history.

14934e3bf61f47e1.column_purpose: Full 6-digit CIP program code (primary key), e.g. 161201 = Classics and Classical Languages. Referenced by CIP_WITH_VERSION and SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE to classify courses/programs.

7d39a62a315a14f1.column_purpose: Official title of the 6-digit CIP program (e.g. 'Transportation Law', 'Financial Forensics and Fraud Investigation'). Slight duplicates arise from title changes across CIP versions.

3fd872543be14ac8.column_purpose: CIP revision edition the row belongs to: 1990, 2000, 2010, or 2020. The table holds the union of codes across these editions.

d7c05d85fce2c054.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (Oracle-style 'DD-MON-YY' text). Two loads: 11-JUN-14 (pre-2020 CIP rows) and 17-MAY-23 (2020 CIP rows).

f8f6125077497cd8.column_purpose: The 2-digit CIP category (leading two digits of the program code), e.g. 43 = Protective Services, 12 = Personal and Miscellaneous Services. The accepted join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is a coincidental numeric match (e.g. 38 = 'CLNT MEETING ROOM') and is semantically invalid; this column does not reference space usage.

fc42a4e8e5189b66.column_purpose: Title of the 2-digit CIP category, e.g. 'PROTECTIVE SERVICES', 'EDUCATION'. Mixed case reflects the style of the CIP edition the row was loaded from.

3e4325b7fd5c8c7e.column_purpose: Concatenation of the 6-digit program code and the 4-digit version year (e.g. 430107 + 1990 = 4301071990). Uniquely identifies a program code within a CIP edition; it is the table's primary key.

82ad2e182bcb6947.column_purpose: The 4-digit CIP series code (middle two digits of the program code), e.g. 4301 = Criminal Justice and Corrections.

844170a3d0ae0719.column_purpose: Title of the 4-digit CIP series, e.g. 'Criminal Justice and Corrections', 'Medical Residency Programs'. Case varies with CIP edition.

d2fa328b26596ec5.column_purpose: The 6-digit CIP program code (e.g. 430107 = Law Enforcement/Police Science). References CIP.PROGRAM_CODE in the unversioned CIP table.

e044f3cffc486364.column_purpose: Title of the 6-digit instructional program, e.g. 'LAW ENFORCEMENT/POLICE SCIENCE', 'Veterinary Surgery'. Case varies with CIP edition.

03b232d4f14c3cf9.column_purpose: The CIP revision edition this row's definition belongs to: 1990, 2000, 2010, or 2020.

6c8bdecdda2f08c9.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (Oracle DD-MON-YY format); each CIP edition was loaded on a single date (e.g. 2020 edition loaded 17-MAY-23).

be0e5833676d48ed.column_purpose: Academic year of the catalog entry (2002-2009), stored as a 4-digit string.

e9ca98bb2eef64e5.column_purpose: Code flagging the subject as fulfilling a Communication Intensive (CI) requirement; only value 'CIM' (Communication Intensive Major). Null when not applicable.

4d7363907ea319e1.column_purpose: Plain-text description of COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE, e.g. 'Communication Intensive Major'.

58d6fcd2d26b3b2c.column_purpose: MIT department/course code owning the subject (e.g. 15=Management, 6=EECS, 21F=Global Studies & Languages). References SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.

97b5c897ad1a30d8.column_purpose: Name of the owning department, e.g. 'Management', 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'.

13839f70e81ef74d.column_purpose: Number of units credited as design work within the subject (MIT unit breakdown: lecture/lab/preparation/design); 0 for almost all subjects.

7483af0c4aae5735.column_purpose: Term (YYYY + FA/JA/SP/SU) from which this catalog record is effective; references ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE.

c54846754a7dc7ce.column_purpose: Free-text list of subjects considered equivalent to this one for credit purposes; blank when none. Plausible reading only - could also mean 'substitutable subjects' in a narrower sense.

18a522b53baa299d.column_purpose: Instructor name(s) teaching the subject in the fall term; 'Staff' when unassigned; multiple instructors comma-separated.

3264aadc6f333c06.column_purpose: Code identifying which General Institute Requirement (GIR) the subject fulfills (e.g. REST, LAB, partial GIR categories); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE. Null when the subject fulfills no GIR.

3d771b0aa1386a0f.column_purpose: Plain-text description of GIR_ATTRIBUTE, e.g. 'Restricted Electives in Science & Technology' or a lab GIR category.

feca9ab5b517a487.column_purpose: Country or countries the subject's content/global focus relates to (for global-education designated subjects); blank for most rows. Plausible reading only - could instead list countries of travel/study components.

f1607bda6528cb09.column_purpose: World region(s) the subject's global focus relates to (e.g. Asia, Europe, Latin America); blank for most rows. Plausible reading only - could instead be a region-of-travel field.

5c1e3ebc069397bf.column_purpose: Code for repeat/credit rule: R=repeatable for credit, N=not repeatable, J=continuing and repeatable, T=continuing.

285d5ce26d734681.column_purpose: Plain-text description of GRADE_RULE, e.g. 'Can be repeated for credit'.

85f8a9eda1cf19fd.column_purpose: Grading option code: L=letter graded, P=pass/D/fail (P/D/F).

2df23ad6956da560.column_purpose: Plain-text description of GRADE_TYPE: 'Letter graded' or 'P/D/F'.

7026cdbf5ef1f07a.column_purpose: Code identifying the HASS (Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences) category the subject fulfills (e.g. HASS-A, HASS-H, HASS-S); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE. Null when not a HASS subject.

ec3ea60f72d8b612.column_purpose: Plain-text description of HASS_ATTRIBUTE, e.g. 'Humanities', 'Arts', 'Social Sciences'.

1ad2e1a871227747.column_purpose: Subject level code: U=Undergraduate, G=Graduate, H=High Graduate (graduate-level subject open to advanced undergraduates).

29a3aad02aabc9c5.column_purpose: Exception or note to the subject's level code (HGN_CODE), e.g. restrictions on which student levels may enroll despite the nominal level. Plausible reading only - could also be a second level code for subjects cross-listed at two levels.

04811815e2c4ba3c.column_purpose: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the fall term.

c5f38711a175693f.column_purpose: Y/N flag: subject is offered during Independent Activities Period (January).

b962375f2b866bf0.column_purpose: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the spring term.

7642d5902d8805a0.column_purpose: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the summer term.

81c323273f247cab.column_purpose: Y/N flag: subject is offered at all during this academic year (null for some rows).

8de2c333fd5c4c10.column_purpose: Y/N flag: subject description appears in the printed course bulletin.

696fedafa461d1c1.column_purpose: Y/N flag: subject carries a variable number of units (arranged with instructor).

6b5502a4a202a0bc.column_purpose: Free-text list of subject IDs jointly offered with this subject (same content, multiple listings across departments); blank when none. Plausible reading only - could also mean subjects that must be taken together.

e19d6c4d7334d504.column_purpose: Lab portion of the subject's unit count; always 0 in this extract (no lab-unit subjects present).

6ad5456fbb931546.column_purpose: Date the catalog record was last updated (Oracle DD-MON-YY format).

92d1787a8cfe461f.column_purpose: Lecture/recitation portion of the subject's weekly unit count (0-6).

4ddf38a3b3680bdc.column_purpose: Subject ID of the master/primary listing when this subject is a joint or cross-listed offering; otherwise likely equals SUBJECT_ID. Plausible reading only - could instead be a warehouse surrogate key for the subject.

efa60951539fcfd5.column_purpose: Free-text list of subject IDs whose classes meet together with this subject (shared classroom/instruction, distinct credit); blank when none. Plausible reading only - could overlap with joint-listing semantics.

00ca116c2197c300.column_purpose: Page number of the subject's entry in the online version of the course bulletin/catalog. Plausible reading only - could be a display ordering number rather than a true page reference.

9ef13b66d11ff026.column_purpose: Preparation/homework portion of the subject's weekly unit count (0-18).

5bc11d613f3c6d54.column_purpose: Free-text prerequisite statement, e.g. '7.03, 7.05, 7.06' or 'Permission of instructor'.

8c6365da45c7f108.column_purpose: Subject identifier as printed in the bulletin; usually equals SUBJECT_ID but may show ranges (e.g. '7.340–7.349') or blanks.

0c9d2e82a235ab4c.column_purpose: Flag or code indicating the subject counts as a school-wide elective (acceptable toward degree requirements across the school's programs). Plausible reading only - could be a list of schools for which it is an elective.

07dc52405d044a0b.column_purpose: Subject identifier as recorded in the source system; nearly identical to SUBJECT_ID.

087c82226bec3d2e.column_purpose: Instructor name(s) teaching the subject in the spring term; 'Staff' when unassigned. Identical distribution to FALL_INSTRUCTORS suggests it may be copied rather than term-specific.

bfbe3aef5fd95ad2.column_purpose: Code or note describing a change in the subject's catalog status (e.g. new, revised, discontinued, renumbered) relative to the prior year's catalog. Plausible reading only - could also be a simple active/inactive status flag.

a58853cafe75d8e9.column_purpose: Course/subject prefix (department number or letter code, e.g. '15', '21F', 'SP'); references SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.

a3bbac9f2a7b8127.column_purpose: Full catalog description of the subject; null for many rows (special topics/thesis subjects often lack one).

93455faf9fa10778.column_purpose: Full MIT subject number (course number + subject number, e.g. '7.414', 'CMS.THU'); the natural key of the catalog entry.

9c4d0100a4dc7227.column_purpose: The number part of the subject ID within the course (e.g. '951', 'THU', 'NIV').

9c7003030c71692a.column_purpose: Abbreviated subject title used in listings (e.g. 'CMS THESIS').

62ff6bbbb1893f10.column_purpose: Full subject title (e.g. 'Undergraduate Thesis in Comparative Media Studies').

7e84ba4238b88ac6.column_purpose: Code for supervisor-based subject types: UROP (undergraduate research), THG (graduate thesis), THU (undergraduate thesis); null otherwise.

10ac64800b035398.column_purpose: Plain-text description of SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE: 'UROP subject', 'Grad Thesis', 'Undergrad Thesis'.

51cd0e61f31d34e4.column_purpose: Code indicating the duration of the subject's offering within a term (e.g. full term vs. first/second half-term). Plausible reading only - could instead be the number of terms the subject runs.

d2a08b4c73936bc2.column_purpose: Total MIT credit units for the subject (0-24); 0 for variable-unit subjects.

317fd4670fd11394.column_purpose: Tuition-related attribute code: RESH=pre-thesis research subject, NTRN=internship; references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

0f2c93f81515a5d2.column_purpose: Plain-text description of TUITION_ATTRIBUTE: 'Pre-thesis Research Subject', 'Internship'.

3288a73efa0c2a73.column_purpose: Date this row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this extract.

1e9510fd290f9bce.column_purpose: Code flagging fulfillment of the MIT Writing Requirement; only value 'WRT2' (Phase II). Null when not applicable.

eecf8c6f6cddd82f.column_purpose: Plain-text description of WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE: 'Writing Requirement, Phase II'.

24c2c960b566d2fc.column_purpose: Group flag distinguishing the two attribute schemes: 'H' = HASS_ATTRIBUTE (students entering Fall 2010 or later), 'G' = GIR_ATTRIBUTE (students entering prior to Fall 2010).

0f2770b865dab07b.column_purpose: Human-readable explanation of the group code: 'HASS_ATTRIBUTE, for students entering in Fall 2010 or later' or 'GIR_ATTRIBUTE, for students entering prior to Fall 2010'.

8a082c172000e83d.column_purpose: How the attribute is displayed in the course bulletin, e.g. 'HASS-A', 'HASS-D 2', 'HASS-A, HASS-H'.

e2981a346a693f4b.column_purpose: How the attribute is displayed on forms/registration UI, e.g. 'HASS Arts', 'HASS-D, Category 2', 'Arts + Humanities'.

71c78a8fe945d95b.column_purpose: The attribute code itself (HA, HH, HS, HD1-HD5, HE, and combinations like 'HA,HH'); joins to SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE to tag subjects with HASS categories.

790c762e3d6b4f1f.column_purpose: Filename of the GIF icon used to display the attribute on the web (e.g. hassS.gif, hassAH.gif); null for rows without an icon.

f132c27722c8e5d2.column_purpose: Height in pixels of the attribute's display icon; always 16 when present.

e7a56b065d039452.column_purpose: Width in pixels of the attribute's display icon; 16 for single-letter icons, 35 for two-letter combination icons. The detected join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is spurious (numeric coincidence), not a real reference.

b0dbafeb4cb0a92a.column_purpose: Date the row was last modified in the source system (Oracle DD-MON-YY format).

e50370961f99074b.column_purpose: Username of the person who last updated the row (always 'PETECHOI' in this snapshot).

6e464e07f76ac395.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (all rows 19-DEC-24).

32ed9d51f41e54f7.column_purpose: Academic year of the offering term (e.g. 2024 for 2024SP/2024FA), 2002-2025.

56a0a318a1342125.column_purpose: Code for the Communication Intensive requirement attribute (CIM/CIH/CIHW); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

a1223687212473b5.column_purpose: Plain-text description of COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE (e.g. 'Communication Intensive Major').

ddd34f523a5ab138.column_purpose: MIT department/course code owning the subject (e.g. 6 = EECS, 15 = Management); references SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.

386ad834e5a93df3.column_purpose: Name of the owning department (e.g. 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci').

b6053ef2d00b98ae.column_purpose: Design portion of the subject's credit units (MIT unit system: 1 unit ~ 1 hour/week); 0 for most subjects.

6839e31e5a9faf29.column_purpose: Catalog term from which this subject record is effective (e.g. 2016FA); references ACADEMIC_TERMS.

e2f9361d7a42d9c3.column_purpose: Payroll classification/rank code (26 distinct values), e.g. 'Grad Std Fellow' (graduate student fellow), 'Grad Std RA' (graduate research assistant), 'Admin Staff', 'Dept Hd/Dir-Ten' (tenured department head/director), 'Inst Professors' (institute professors).

4af4407312f94818.column_purpose: Financial clearing/cost collector number assigned to the department (SAP-style cost center identifier, 7-digit). 88bd04382825369c.column_purpose: Telephone area code for the department's phone number, stored separately from the 7-digit local number in DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER (MIT campus numbers are in the 617 area code).

72af9efafe9e65ee.column_purpose: Department's 7-digit campus phone number (MIT 617-area local number, stored without area code). Null for ~57% of departments.

67e36f6304084661.column_purpose: Primary key: the SIS administrative department code (e.g. AERO, BE, 21F, 15D). Referenced by SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_SUMMARY, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, and COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED to assign subjects to departments.

bc4d75c22f94063a.column_purpose: Full name of the administrative department (e.g. 'Biological Engineering Div.', 'Baptist Ministry', 'School of Engineering Office').

2a282b29290095d0.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (single value 19-DEC-24 for all rows, i.e. the last full refresh).

5bcd37512ae6e07d.column_purpose: US NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code for the course/program; references CIP.PROGRAM_CODE.

f769b2cdec5f9c42.column_purpose: Course identifier, typically the department/subject number plus an option suffix (e.g. '24', '3 P', 'HST AEM'). Corresponds to the department portion of the key plus option. Tentative: it may instead be a purely display-oriented concatenation of department and option rather than an independent identifier.

51575ed139a085eb.column_purpose: Short/abbreviated name of the course or program (e.g. 'Linguistics & Philosophy', 'Mat Sci & Eng - M.Eng').

814599d487285b15.column_purpose: Full/official name of the course or program (e.g. 'Linguistics and Philosophy', 'Health Sciences and Technology').

984b23d28ca7882b.column_purpose: Level of the course: 'G' = Graduate, 'U' = Undergraduate.

2bb18ccf1ffeffa3.column_purpose: Option/track within the course (e.g. 'P', 'AEM', 'NIV', 'NIE'). Null when the course has no option. Tentative: individual code meanings are unclear; NIV/NIE may denote non-Institute exchange or special programs (cf. STUDENT_DEPARTMENT's alphabetic special-program codes), but this is not confirmed.

6df612967848fd47.column_purpose: MIT degree abbreviation expected for students in this course: NDG = no degree granted, SM = Master of Science, SB = Bachelor of Science, DOC = Doctorate, MNG = Master of Engineering, plus others (MBA, MCP, HA).

280edbdeec7889ba.column_purpose: MIT department/course code owning the course (e.g. '12' = Earth, Atmospheric & Planetary Sciences, '15' = Management, 'HST' = Health Sciences & Technology); references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE.

d81ffc8c2ac2687a.column_purpose: Short name of the department matching DEPARTMENT code (e.g. 'Earth, Atmos & Planetary Sci').

28e0b54105c88544.column_purpose: Formal department name as printed in the commencement program book (e.g. 'Department of Linguistics and Philosophy'). Null for non-degree/cross-enrollment rows.

f821cb690eded14c.column_purpose: Term code (e.g. 2001FA, 2015JA) from which this course description row is effective; '000000' = Beginning of Time. Format YYYY + FA/SP/SU/JA.

fd929e268109e6ce.column_purpose: Human-readable description of FROM_TERM (e.g. 'Fall Term 2000-2001', 'Beginning of Time').

63014d3c4e3671c2.column_purpose: Graduate sub-level: 'Masters' or 'Doctoral'; null for undergraduate/non-degree rows. Appears to be a misspelled duplicate of GRADUATE_LEVEL.

2be74949056f3f50.column_purpose: Graduate sub-level: 'Masters' or 'Doctoral'; null for undergraduate/non-degree rows.

5fb1374cfe56d8fd.column_purpose: Y/N flag indicating whether the course is a degree-granting program.

456532b7f4c77d52.column_purpose: Date the record was last updated in the source system, in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. 23-JUL-15).

86347fa8085cac8b.column_purpose: Abbreviated MIT school the course belongs to (Engineering, Science, Hum Arts & Social Sciences, Architecture and Planning, MIT academic, Non-MIT, etc.).

e833d74db974ce29.column_purpose: Formal school name as printed in the commencement program book (e.g. 'School of Engineering').

5287877c2c5be84b.column_purpose: Primary key: composite of DEPARTMENT : COURSE_OPTION : COURSE_LEVEL (e.g. '24::G', '3:P:G', 'HST:AEM:G').

25709c1f73330b8e.column_purpose: Term code through which this course description row is effective; '999999' = End of Time (currently active). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

e9ea53657d7cbef1.column_purpose: Human-readable description of THRU_TERM (e.g. 'Fall Term 2003-2004', 'End of Time').

bc4a0eb22a328f68.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant 19-DEC-24 for this snapshot.

cf28c63c883c49a4.column_purpose: Short SIS department code (MIT course number like '1', '21F', '4', or alpha codes like 'HASS', 'ODGE', 'ARC'). Nearly unique (127 distinct of 128 rows, one null).

5118bbc08f95bfb0.column_purpose: Canonical department identifier: code + '-' + name (e.g. '1-Civil and Environmental Eng'). Used as join key by STUDENT_DEPARTMENT and SUBJECT_GROUPING.

5758d27b44439d60.column_purpose: Date of last recorded activity/change for the department record, in Oracle DD-MON-YY format. Many rows share 17-FEB-94, suggesting a bulk load then.

534d8e82adf5747b.column_purpose: Human-readable department name without the code prefix (e.g. 'History', 'Anthropology').

dcab21a51f4a713c.column_purpose: Y/N flag indicating whether the department grants degrees.

317f4c1c4825bfd0.column_purpose: Code of the MIT school the department belongs to: E=Engineering, H=Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, Y=MIT academic (Science etc.), Z=Non-MIT, X=MIT non-academic, plus others (T, S).

222b6dec9dfa7c8a.column_purpose: Name of the school corresponding to SCHOOL_CODE (e.g. 'Engineering', 'Hum, Arts & Social Sciences', 'Non-MIT').

0506cc902d9fecd5.column_purpose: Formal school name as printed in the commencement program (e.g. 'School of Engineering'). Null where not applicable.

0edf537271230d14.column_purpose: ETL load date of the row into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows.

eb8b4b045a613342.column_purpose: Short alphanumeric code within a lookup category (e.g. RE = Registered, N = New Regular Grad Student). Not unique across categories, so it is only meaningful together with LOOKUP_TYPE. A few rows have null CODE.

aeb5ec8f5adf21cf.column_purpose: Human-readable meaning of the code (e.g. 'Registered', 'Dropped, No Tuition', '3/4 Time', 'Listener'). One row has the placeholder '?', i.e. unknown description.

405351ad268d679a.column_purpose: Category of the code set: Registration Status, Enrollment Status, Load Level, Registration Group, Registration Type, and one unidentified type (sample value 'HGN') whose meaning is unresolved.

2138136fe9503bc4.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; all rows show 19-DEC-24, indicating a single full load. Stored as text in DD-MON-YY format.

a78381cbf0592527.column_purpose: Primary key. The subject/course code (e.g. '11', 'MCI', '21F') used to join to course offering and catalog tables. Appears identical to SUBJECT_CODE.

e5555a44925957a3.column_purpose: Code of the MIT school the department belongs to (A = Architecture and Planning, E = Engineering, H = Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, S = Science, Z = Non-MIT, etc.). No join detected, so specific code meanings beyond those inferred from SCHOOL_NAME are tentative.

b17bdf25a3bcfca2.column_purpose: Name of the school corresponding to SCHOOL_CODE (e.g. 'Engineering', 'Non-MIT', 'Architecture and Planning').

33f0ddc82237a15a.column_purpose: Same values as COURSE_NUMBER; the subject/course code. Not part of the primary key but duplicates it.

2de187e481eee9bb.column_purpose: Full room identifier in 'building-room' format, e.g. 10-436E, 32-G404H. Nearly unique per row.

bf4710a950097db3.column_purpose: Duplicate of BUILDING_ROOM (identical values in all samples); presumably a display name for the room.

2dafb11ca1c4c2b5.column_purpose: Floor within the building: numeric floors ('0'-'4'...) plus basement/sublevel codes like 'D6','D7','G6'. References SPACE_FLOOR lookup.

f41e988f692c629d.column_purpose: Constant value 1 in all rows; likely a row-counting flag (one room per row) used for aggregation counts. No variation, so meaning beyond a constant is unresolved.

e96c860644c83e93.column_purpose: Room number within the building, including suffixes (e.g. '36E', '94B', '51D'); combined with building number forms BUILDING_ROOM.

4a22cc77afa72703.column_purpose: Area of the room in square feet (1 to ~108,475; median 147).

da7abc9a2d4b89fe.column_purpose: Key of the organizational unit (department/DLC) occupying or responsible for the room; references SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_KEY / SPACE_UNIT_CODE.

d8cf06f204e97e32.column_purpose: Space usage classification code; references SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY (e.g. 38='CLNT MEETING ROOM', 71='DINING RM', 87='LIBRARY').

ab2616a18dd8e8b0.column_purpose: ETL load date of the row into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this snapshot.

34acb658a2ab5c3e.column_purpose: The floor code within a building, e.g. '0', '1', '17', '29' for numbered floors and codes like 'D6', 'G9' presumably for basement/sub-level or mezzanine floors (exact meaning of the letter prefixes is not evidenced here). Duplicates FLOOR_KEY exactly.

63ffb342bdebaeaf.column_purpose: Primary key of the lookup; the floor code used by SPACE_DETAIL.FLOOR_KEY, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.FLOOR and FCLT_ROOMS_HIST.FLOOR to identify a floor. Identical in value to FLOOR.

5c643d43b70b7cf7.column_purpose: Number of MIT departments/DLCs the supervisor is associated with; 1 for the vast majority (2020 of 2135), up to 4. Matches the number of comma-separated codes in DEPT_NAMES.

76447429437b377d.column_purpose: Comma-separated list of MIT department/DLC codes (e.g. D_EAPS, D_LIBRARIES, D_SLOAN, D_ALUM, D_LFEE) the supervisor belongs to; count matches DEPT_COUNT.

0fad90b6e9a369ae.column_purpose: MIT personal identifier (9-digit) of the supervisor; primary key, one row per person.

811b639776fe3f00.column_purpose: Number of direct reports supervised by this person; ranges 1-121, median 1. The accepted join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is almost certainly coincidental (a small integer matching a lookup key), not a real reference.

2d448296d8e1def7.column_purpose: Research volume (likely dollars) attributed to the supervisor's departments; 0 for ~70% of rows, up to ~9.5M, with negative values likely adjustments or cost transfers. Alternative reading: thousands of dollars. Units not directly evidenced.

3f4ccd9df0192ca8.column_purpose: Research volume per square foot (RESEARCH_VOLUME / SQFT, rounded); 0 where SQFT or research volume is 0.

36e2817ab4e39cd9.column_purpose: Square footage of space assigned to the supervisor (or their department's space under their supervision); 0 for 248 rows (no assigned space).

485dea0f3abf3cd7.column_purpose: Square footage per unit of research volume (SQFT / RESEARCH_VOLUME); 0 where SQFT is 0. Alternative reading: the reciprocal ratio RESEARCH_VOLUME / SQFT misnamed, but the column name and sibling columns (RES_VOL_PER_SQFT, SQFT_PER_SUPERVISEE) support SQFT divided by research volume.

a39108bcffefa094.column_purpose: Square footage per supervisee (SQFT / NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES); equals SQFT when there is 1 supervisee, 0 when SQFT is 0.

7f6197d2f3243198.column_purpose: Department/Lab/Center (DLC) code, prefixed 'D_', linking the space unit to the master department hierarchy (MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY). Null where the space unit has no DLC mapping.

58a13fb4595f56cc.column_purpose: Surrogate key for the organization in the facilities system (FCLT_ORGANIZATION / FAC_ORGANIZATION); unique per row here, referenced by FCLT_ROOMS and FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST.

a5d90a5a7e4d8e4e.column_purpose: Human-readable name of the space-occupying unit (e.g., 'Mechanical Engineering', 'List Visual Arts Center'). Nulls align with DLC_KEY nulls.

758d71c7422838ca.column_purpose: Numeric HR/space department code (e.g., 266300 for Mechanical Engineering); identical to SPACE_UNIT_KEY in every row. Referenced by SPACE_DETAIL, SPACE_UNIT2, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD, and matched to HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD in FAC/FCLT_ORGANIZATION.

db519ea502934b5f.column_purpose: Primary key of the table; numerically identical to SPACE_UNIT_CODE (HR department number). Used as the join key into SPACE_DETAIL and SPACE_UNIT2.

58de4b8aacea625b.column_purpose: ETL load timestamp of the row into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows in this snapshot.

be9d92a359f5a77b.column_purpose: Department, Lab, or Center key (DLC code) identifying the organizational unit that owns/occupies the space, e.g. D_CHANCELLOR, D_MECHE, D_LIT. References MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY. Nulls (~5%) likely for units without a mapped DLC.

60552886456c64fb.column_purpose: Name of the space unit (department, lab, center, or facility) occupying the space, e.g. 'LITERATURE', 'MCGOVERN INSTITUTE', 'WALLACE ASTRO OB'. Matches FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME.

b8ed4a56d8ed627a.column_purpose: Numeric code identifying the space unit; identical in value to SPACE_UNIT_KEY in this table. Joins to SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE / SPACE_UNIT_KEY.

2dfb0d238efeb425.column_purpose: Numeric key for the space unit; in this table it carries the same values as SPACE_UNIT_CODE (both are the unit's code). Joins to SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_KEY.

cca5d0a44b75d4d4.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows, indicating a single full-load snapshot.

d11672bc5b4d6f43.column_purpose: Short uppercase label describing how a room/space is used (e.g., RSRC RM = resource room, TRNG RM = training room, DSGN STUDIO = design studio, DINING RM = dining room, IT HLPDSK = IT help desk). Abbreviated coded text.

8fa8ed08543d512f.column_purpose: Surrogate primary key for the usage category; joined by SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_USAGE_KEY to classify rooms by usage. Other listed joins are spurious statistical matches on small integers.

115f9b1ef10f4bf9.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' (Dec 19, 2024) for all rows in this snapshot.

f8f9badf85eaf2ca.column_purpose: Course number in Roman numerals as printed in the MIT commencement book (e.g. 'Course XII' = Course 12, 'Course VI' = Course 6). Variants like 'Course VI-P' and 'Course FIRST YEAR' are legacy commencement-book labels.

1dca6d5e138da5a6.column_purpose: Cross-reference label used in the commencement book pointing to where this degree is listed (e.g. 'S.M., Without Spec.', 'Ph.D., W.H.O.I.'). Alternative reading: it could instead be a note directing readers to a related degree program entry; the exact semantics is not documented.

8b5d2f700a0b7318.column_purpose: MIT course number (department number plus optional program suffix), e.g. '2 M' = Course 2 Mechanical Engineering, '21W', 'SCM 2B'. Corresponds to the Roman-numeral course in the commencement book.

48a0b1e5168b7a0c.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last recorded activity/update for this course/program record. Alternative reading: it could be the last term date on which the course itself was offered rather than a record-maintenance timestamp.

0b7b169fb912a8c7.column_purpose: Level of the degree program: 'G' = graduate, 'U' = undergraduate.

3ad424a9c3898a15.column_purpose: Opaque code identifying the specific degree program, typically degree type + course/option (e.g. 'SMWS2' = S.M. without specification, Course 2; 'SB10B' = S.B. Course 10-B; 'PHD' = Ph.D.).

756db1a35706740d.column_purpose: Full official description of the degree program (degree title and field, e.g. 'Master of Science in Management of Technology').

406fe96219e8bbc2.column_purpose: Abbreviated version of the degree program description.

49c5bffdc0c8866f.column_purpose: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last recorded activity/update for this degree record. Alternative reading: it could be the last date the degree program was conferred or active rather than a record-maintenance timestamp.

89b18172e0788e35.column_purpose: Abbreviation of the degree type: SB (Bachelor of Science), SM (Master of Science), PHD, SCD, ENG, MCP, MBA, etc.

c9441cc814fbe622.column_purpose: Full name of the degree type corresponding to DEGREE_TYPE (e.g. 'Master of Science', 'Doctor of Philosophy').

94f1c8a88b259a17.column_purpose: Numeric weight/rank of the degree type, likely used for ordering or counting highest degree (SB=1, SM=3, ENG=6, PHD/SCD=8). Exact semantics of the scale is not documented.

86d1a62e311d8e17.column_purpose: MIT department code (e.g. '12' = Earth, Atmospheric & Planetary Sciences, '6' = EECS, '1' = Civil and Environmental Engineering); references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE.

254891855d973f8c.column_purpose: Department name as printed in the commencement book (includes historical names such as 'Department of Ocean Engineering' and 'Department of Meteorology').

4fd0cd5d37e6e0eb.column_purpose: Academic term code (e.g. '1985SP', '2004FA') from which this degree program was valid/offered; '000000' indicates no recorded start term. References ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

568b66662217ac16.column_purpose: Flag indicating whether this degree program counts as a double major ('Y'/'N').

e4cf2f20f8a8ca7e.column_purpose: MIT school the degree program belongs to, as printed in the commencement book (School of Engineering, School of Science, etc.).

9a4bfbc66aede37f.column_purpose: Academic term code through which this degree program was valid; '999999' indicates still active/open-ended. References ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

30e46de96d9241e9.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; single value '19-DEC-24' for all rows, indicating a full refresh on that date.

a06e5e1453ef28f1.column_purpose: Label of the financial aid year, e.g. 'Aid Year 2004-2005'.

11964030983fa5ae.column_purpose: Fiscal accounting period as YYYYPP, where YYYY is the fiscal year (starting July 1) and PP the period number within it (e.g. 200508 for Feb 2005 = FY2005 period 8).

32c6c046d2813151.column_purpose: Label of the fiscal period, e.g. 'FY 2005 Period 8'.

2c5ca75af0cc0f36.column_purpose: Fiscal year containing the date; runs July-June, so Feb 2005 is FY2005 while Sep 1960 is FY1961.

8330c2197dbdc494.column_purpose: First day of the calendar month containing the date, DD-MON-YY.

1c8e7b93ef815013.column_purpose: Code for the academic term the month falls in, e.g. 2000FA (Fall), 2022SP (Spring), 2028SU (Summer), 2001JA (January/IAP). References ACADEMIC_TERMS. Null when the month falls outside any academic term (e.g. summer closing months).

fd205e923684e342.column_purpose: Human-readable form of ACADEMIC_TERM, e.g. 'Fall Term 1999-2000', 'Summer Term 2028'. Nulls match ACADEMIC_TERM.

4ff786414e8eb1ac.column_purpose: Ending calendar year of the academic year the month belongs to (e.g. 2000 for Fall Term 1999-2000). Null when no academic term applies.

ee02033ef27e22fd.column_purpose: Calendar month number 1-12 of the period.

7534c7ec6e64b0e0.column_purpose: Name of the calendar month, e.g. 'June', 'November'.

0c46e0d687849731.column_purpose: Unique code for the calendar month, YYYYMM (e.g. 199911); closing periods get a suffix like '202806P16' for June 2028 fiscal period 16.

628a90964e1a1b14.column_purpose: Human-readable calendar period, e.g. 'November 1999', 'June 2028, fiscal period 16'.

78acb740217115e8.column_purpose: Last calendar date of the month, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format (e.g. '30-NOV-99', '28-FEB-22').

9ef6794929b49a03.column_purpose: Starting year of the financial aid award year the month belongs to (aid year runs like 1999-2000, coded as 2000 here per FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR_DESC 'Aid Year 1999-2000' -> 2000). Null for months outside the aid year (e.g. summer closing months).

d2d5235d0875f2c1.column_purpose: Human-readable aid year, e.g. 'Aid Year 1999-2000'. Nulls match FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.

45a43cb855a7f5b0.column_purpose: Fiscal period key, YYYYNN where YYYY is the fiscal year (ending) and NN the period number (1-12 for months July-June, 13-16 for closing periods). E.g. 200005 = FY2000 period 5 = November 1999. Referenced by facility history tables and TIME_QUARTER.

58617dd6f9f3f432.column_purpose: Human-readable fiscal period, e.g. 'FY 2000 Period 5', 'FY 2028 closing period 4'.

c78a8b86ad325e2a.column_purpose: Display/selector string combining code and month, e.g. '200005 -- November 1999', '201215 -- June 2012 Closing'.

73678ed7ca6d85fb.column_purpose: Fiscal year (July-June, labeled by ending year), 1996-2035.

8457e05dbf980bc9.column_purpose: Human-readable fiscal quarter, e.g. 'FY 2000 Quarter 2'. References TIME_QUARTER.FY_QUARTER_NAME.

3531c3af6dd302b8.column_purpose: Compact fiscal quarter code, e.g. 'FY2000Q2'. References TIME_QUARTER.FY_QUARTER_CODE.

b9928418ac952926.column_purpose: Y/N flag: Y for fiscal closing periods (13-16, the June closing months), N for regular monthly periods.

ac33675ef7683f99.column_purpose: Y/N flag: Y for the single row representing the current fiscal period as of the data snapshot.

e59fe347b12fb299.column_purpose: Y/N flag: Y for the 16 rows of the current fiscal year as of the data snapshot.

1ff3cf71da27ef23.column_purpose: Y/N flag: Y for the single row representing the immediately preceding fiscal period.

f13f6fc773e98893.column_purpose: First calendar date of the month, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format (e.g. '01-NOV-99').

3df81b4da84ac7c6.column_purpose: Primary key of the table (surrogate/primary identifier), identical to FISCAL_PERIOD (YYYYNN). Referenced by FRC_FISCAL_PERIODS, facility history tables, and TIME_QUARTER start/end period columns.

30efd4526161ecd5.column_purpose: Calendar year (Gregorian) in which the quarter falls, e.g. 2003. Each year appears 4 times (one per quarter).

ca2ccdc0a8b00610.column_purpose: Unique code for the calendar quarter, format CY<year>Q<1-4>, e.g. CY2003Q4.

6b43372f45fc5a51.column_purpose: Human-readable calendar quarter label, e.g. 'CY 2003 Quarter 4'.

5e27f4bdc6c95bd4.column_purpose: Fiscal year (July-June) the quarter belongs to. Calendar Q3/Q4 belong to the following fiscal year (CY2003Q4 -> FY2004).

9a401adfd32e3549.column_purpose: Primary key. Unique fiscal quarter code, format FY<year>Q<1-4>, e.g. FY2004Q2. Referenced by TIME_MONTH.FY_QUARTER_CODE.

ddd656ae01d78e8f.column_purpose: Human-readable fiscal quarter label, e.g. 'FY 2004 Quarter 2'.

58a557825b867ebc.column_purpose: Y/N flag: whether this quarter is the current quarter as of the warehouse load (exactly one row is Y).

8926a73a6ffa7908.column_purpose: Y/N flag: whether the quarter is in the future relative to the load date (42 rows Y).

9d9cb594f3d34cd6.column_purpose: Y/N flag: whether this is the quarter immediately following the current one. All rows are N in this snapshot (the next quarter likely falls outside the loaded range or the flag was not populated).

8555ddd3b075442d.column_purpose: Y/N flag: whether the quarter is in the past relative to the load date (101 rows Y).

d54660ca5fe570d5.column_purpose: Y/N flag: whether this is the quarter immediately before the current one. All rows are N in this snapshot.

87286f875728a5e1.column_purpose: Key for the payroll effort-certification (ED/ACCA) quarterly schedule, format YYYYQQ (fiscal year + fiscal quarter number), e.g. 200402 for FY2004 Q2. Matches QUARTER_START_FP.

78e0cfeaf650e33d.column_purpose: Due date for the quarterly effort certification, DD-MON-YY; falls about a month after quarter end (e.g. 31-MAR-04 for the Oct-Dec 2003 quarter).

a87df068eb931ca4.column_purpose: Expected return date for the quarterly effort certification, DD-MON-YY; end of the month following quarter end (e.g. 29-FEB-04).

0b2e9694b12549bb.column_purpose: Date the quarterly certification period opens, DD-MON-YY; equals the quarter start date (e.g. 01-JAN-04).

9822f5fb6a196045.column_purpose: Last calendar date of the quarter, DD-MON-YY (e.g. 31-DEC-03).

cae85cee3e6e3357.column_purpose: Fiscal period (YYYYMM) of the last month in the quarter, e.g. 200406 for the quarter ending Dec 2003 (fiscal period numbering continues July=01). Joins to TIME_MONTH fiscal period keys.

a7638468d90f5877.column_purpose: First calendar date of the quarter, DD-MON-YY (e.g. 01-OCT-03).

2a1a64216620082a.column_purpose: Fiscal period (YYYYMM) of the first month in the quarter, e.g. 200404 for the quarter starting Oct 2003. Joins to TIME_MONTH fiscal period keys.

2c4e0473acae5bac.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant 20-DEC-24 for all rows in this snapshot.

c159b794e39922eb.column_purpose: ISBN of the textbook/material (ISBN-13 mostly, some ISBN-10). Null when the course has no materials or the material has no ISBN; '0' or ' ' used as placeholder. References TIP_MATERIAL.ISBN.

e4e21dd4ac50cd31.column_purpose: Constant 1 in all rows; a row-count/ETL flag column, not meaningful data.

ef4a046185dc8b51.column_purpose: MIT subject (course) number, e.g. '21L.003', '14.781'. Values like 'CANC.BARCHARTS'/'CANC.SPO' appear to be cancelled or special (non-standard) subject entries.

0f9554279ae6f7de.column_purpose: Academic term code, e.g. 2013FA, 2016SU, 2024JA (January IAP). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE.

9dbe80ed1846d811.column_purpose: Composite key for the material record: ISBN + material title + edition(?) + term code. For courses with no materials it is 'N/A' + 'Course has no materials' + term code.

5da24851c2278d96.column_purpose: Two-letter code for the material's status in the course, joined to the TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS lookup (key/code columns) to get the label. Examples: RQ = required, RC = recommended, NM = course has no materials, BR = bookstore recommends, CL = go to class first, EO = likely optional, U = unknown, NL = no label. Exact meanings of some codes (e.g. EO) are inferred from common TIP usage and the lookup's partial labels.

0a3e7913735b57b3.column_purpose: Composite key for the subject offering: zero-padded subject number (dots removed) + a 3-digit section/level code (e.g. '000') + term code. Identifies the subject-term offering this material belongs to.

fc3b05f58bb14034.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '20-DEC-24' for this extract.

e65126703f83dd2a.column_purpose: Author(s) of the material, in 'Last, First' catalog format, sometimes multiple authors separated by semicolons. Placeholder values like 'NOT FOUND on ISBN.org' and 'Unknown' indicate lookup failures.

1ec3d359db246367.column_purpose: Edition number of the book, mostly as a plain number ('2', '3'), sometimes with year ('2nd 98'). Heavily null (70%) and padded with spaces; values like '40', '70' suggest dirty data or non-edition content.

249a76d5f2c2d09b.column_purpose: ISBN (mostly ISBN-13, 978-prefixed) identifying the book/material. '0' indicates missing/unknown ISBN. Referenced by TIP_DETAIL.ISBN.

dc94b30955ddeec0.column_purpose: Code for where the material's metadata came from: 'ISBN' (ISBN.org lookup), 'COOP' (MIT Coop bookstore), 'OTI' (likely 'other' source, but exact expansion not evidenced).

d686530dc7cd196f.column_purpose: Shelf (retail) price in US dollars for a new copy of the material.

8e8e73170989f9a6.column_purpose: Publisher of the material. Some values are abbreviated codes ('Vst', 'Yuzu', 'Dgtl Bncom' = digital/B&N?) for digital distributors; others are full publisher names or even full imprint/place strings ('New York, Wiley [1975]') from library-style cataloging.

15c672496da3ff6d.column_purpose: Rental price in US dollars for a new copy; 0 (92% of rows) means rental not offered or no price.

8470b538255cdc5b.column_purpose: Rental price in US dollars for a used copy; 0 (92% of rows) means rental not offered or no price.

71950f264cd3c646.column_purpose: Primary key: concatenation of ISBN + abbreviated title + edition/year + term code (e.g. '142021SP' = spring 2021, '052023SP' = summer 2023). Uniquely identifies a material offered in a specific term.

b72536bfde58ddd5.column_purpose: Title of the book/material; 'Ebk ' prefix denotes e-book versions. Padded with trailing spaces in some rows.

307430e84271e004.column_purpose: Shelf (retail) price in US dollars for a used copy; 0 means no used copies offered.

e8e542aa5702c524.column_purpose: Publication/copyright year of the edition (range 1960–2024; 0 = unknown).

b88f7ac09e5b46b5.column_purpose: Human-readable description of the material status (e.g. 'Required', 'Recommended', 'Bookstore recommends', 'Course has no materials', 'Go to class first', 'Val-u option'). Null for some codes (e.g. 'NL'), so not all codes have a label.

b1da7305b16791b1.column_purpose: Two-letter abbreviation code for the material status (BR = Bookstore recommends, NM = Course has no materials, etc.). Duplicates the key column.

971d915579e46ec8.column_purpose: Primary key of the lookup; two-letter code joined to TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY to classify each course material's status.

e800bb649f5eb877.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (all rows '20-DEC-24'); stored as text in DD-MON-YY format.

e45703b6a0cfc776.column_purpose: MIT course (department) number of the subject as offered, e.g. '15' = Management, '6' = EECS, '21M' = Music and Theater Arts. References SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER.

8e80760c9b86c56e.column_purpose: Human-readable name of the course/department number, e.g. '15' -> 'Management', '21M' -> 'Music and Theater Arts'.

c40d85c039798e46.column_purpose: Course number padded with leading spaces (numeric codes) so numeric and alphanumeric course numbers sort correctly; same domain as COURSE_NUMBER.

03aaaf4ee4ae01b5.column_purpose: Y/N flag indicating whether the subject offering has no course material (e.g. no reading/reserve material to collect for TIP). Null (79%) likely means not applicable or not evaluated; the Y/N semantics are plausible but the exact business rule is not directly evidenced, and no joined column provides further support.

c76157c97fe0e290.column_purpose: Course number of the master (primary/cross-listed parent) subject; usually equals COURSE_NUMBER but differs for cross-listed subjects. References SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER.

d3c71593ee0f1a13.column_purpose: Human-readable name of the master course number's department.

a23c48bbd81abdac.column_purpose: Full master subject identifier (course.number, e.g. '2.EPE', '15.792') of the primary subject this offering rolls up to; differs from SUBJECT_ID for cross-listed subjects.

e445e0096e126708.column_purpose: Number of students enrolled in the subject offering that term (0-648, median 5).

e9ca8509c1f93026.column_purpose: Code of the department offering the subject; nearly identical to COURSE_NUMBER (62 vs 58 distinct values, e.g. '21M' vs 'Music').

bcf136771efcbd83.column_purpose: Name of the offering department, e.g. 'Music' (finer-grained than COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, which groups departments into course numbers).

db547341ff270657.column_purpose: MIT school the offering department belongs to: Engineering, Science, Hum Arts & Social Sciences, Architecture and Planning, Sloan Management, etc.

97c5dbe80eafbd04.column_purpose: MIT ID number of the faculty member responsible for the subject offering; null for ~17% of rows (no assigned responsible faculty).

44b2af18a975e483.column_purpose: Name (Last, First) of the responsible faculty member, matching RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.

1852932e741995a1.column_purpose: Full subject identifier of the offering, e.g. '21M.835', '15.220' (course number + subject number).

bdfe496324c5c798.column_purpose: Space-padded sort key for SUBJECT_ID so numeric course numbers sort before alphanumeric ones.

022a90cee596eb0f.column_purpose: Title of the subject, e.g. 'Acting Techniques of Style', 'International Management'.

3b7a2abe089ddf2b.column_purpose: Academic term of the offering in YYYY+session format (FA fall, SP spring, SU summer, JA January/IAP), e.g. 2019FA. References ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE.

b21f6a239c4e74b5.column_purpose: Primary key: subject id zero-padded to 9 chars concatenated with term code, e.g. '21M8350002002FA' = subject 21M.835 in 2002FA.

63a0c8cafed8c11c.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '20-DEC-24' for this extract.

e7e7aaf6cdb82439.column_purpose: The top-level domain / country code (e.g. HU, KG, SB, ARPA). Duplicates TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN_KEY.

b9570b3e4618217c.column_purpose: Name of the country or entity the TLD represents (e.g. Hungary, Kyrgyzstan, Solomon Islands; ARPA = 'Advanced Projects Research Agency').

368eb9b2978f641f.column_purpose: Primary key / join key: the TLD or country code, referenced by IR_INSTITUTION.COUNTRY_CODE. Same values as TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN.

cd8274ba9edaddc5.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse, in DD-MON-YY format (17-JUN-99 for most rows, 21-JUN-99 for one).

af3fe48af9d7fa8c.column_purpose: Type of appointment this record represents; in this extract always 'Primary Appointment' (99% populated, single value). Indicates the person's primary MIT appointment.

551e3ed7ae21339a.column_purpose: Person's email address, derived from Kerberos name plus a domain (worker.com, employee.com, gmail.business.com in this masked/synthetic data). Not unique (0.665 uniqueness) because different people can share initials-based usernames.

3dd1ced56a9b764e.column_purpose: MIT Kerberos/Athena username (typically firstname + last initial), lowercase. Primary account identifier for authentication.

0125045ced376744.column_purpose: Same Kerberos username in uppercase; used for case-insensitive joins, e.g. to PERSON_AUTH_AREA.USER_NAME.

9a4356d368dc0f41.column_purpose: Person's middle name or middle initial; null for about half the records.

120761008c0f77bf.column_purpose: MIT personal identification number (9-digit, 9xxxxxxxx range). Unique across all 10,000 rows; primary key of this table.

a4bb95f51ae08275.column_purpose: Office location in MIT building-room format (e.g. E53-355, 5-172F, NE49), matching MIT building numbers; null for ~11% of rows.

eadfb7d2b9d94fc2.column_purpose: Office phone number stored as digits (values appear masked/scrambled in this extract, so area codes are not meaningful). Null for ~17%.

9bb3a8ccf0531586.column_purpose: Whether the person is an EMPLOYEE (99.8%) or STUDENT (0.2%).

d6ef2fcef08cea0d.column_purpose: Numeric ID of the person's MIT organizational unit/DLC (department, lab, center); pairs with UNIT_NAME (e.g. 310000 = Lincoln Laboratory).

9122d029179f7e41.column_purpose: Name of the person's MIT organizational unit/DLC, e.g. 'Lincoln Laboratory', 'Mechanical Engineering'.

87aa92d1778ba0f8.column_purpose: Name of the Canadian city/locality for the postal code (e.g. St. John's, Corner Brook).

796d67e902a3dde0.column_purpose: Code distinguishing city types; 'D' (dominant, 99.9%) vs 'A' (alternate, 0.1%). Likely marks whether the city name is the primary/official name for the postal code or an alternate/acceptable name. Exact code definitions are not documented, so this reading is plausible but unconfirmed.

3f4117e0851b5eaa.column_purpose: Canadian postal code in 'A1A 1A5' format (letter-digit-letter digit-letter-digit). Primary key of the table.

f5709f96a3f56905.column_purpose: Two-letter Canadian province/territory abbreviation; all rows in this extract are 'NL' (Newfoundland and Labrador).

0499ebe8f2cbd801.column_purpose: Full province name; all rows are 'Newfoundland' (the historical name for Newfoundland and Labrador).

1beaf354bba7d4a0.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse, in DD-MON-YY format; all rows loaded 25-MAY-23.

79444196b6f07e93.column_purpose: Name of the city, town, or postal community served by the ZIP code. Includes military addresses (APO/DPO/FPO) and urbanization names in Puerto Rico ('Urb ...').

f378c1ed1b073973.column_purpose: Code classifying the place type. Values N, D, A. Likely N = non-incorporated community, D = incorporated (default) place, A = APO/military or alternate name; exact code meanings are not documented, so specific mapping is tentative.

3d700faaa90ee491.column_purpose: County (or municipio in Puerto Rico) containing the ZIP code; 'none' where no county applies (e.g. military/APO).

71ae89d328e9ca48.column_purpose: Two-letter USPS state/territory abbreviation (PR, NJ, MA, ME, VT, RI, NY, VI, AE for Armed Forces Europe, etc.).

87920ebb7e78d870.column_purpose: Full name of the state or territory corresponding to STATE_ABBR.

cd465d3bfc774341.column_purpose: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '25-MAY-23' for all rows in this snapshot.

bbf0232fd5882b27.column_purpose: US ZIP code for the row. Stored as a number, so leading zeros are lost (e.g. 715 = 00715 Ponce PR, 926 = 00926 San Juan PR); values are 3-5 digit ZIP codes. Not unique — a ZIP can have multiple rows (e.g. multiple city/county names).

d35c874af0edd676.column_purpose: Code classifying the ZIP record. S = standard ZIP (dominant), P = PO Box ZIP, U = unique (single high-volume recipient), M = military. Exact USPS code meanings inferred from standard conventions.

d8c6a202bf7aef14.column_purpose: Coded access/security level of the room, values 0-3. Exact meaning of each level is not documented here; 2 is most common. Could alternatively be a key-card access tier or a room-lock classification.

614f5062292eb54d.column_purpose: Building number (MIT building code), e.g. 10, 13, 32, 36; some values like '42T' indicate sub-building/wing codes. Part of the room identifier.

05ee16624c04768f.column_purpose: Full room identifier in MIT 'building-room' format, e.g. '10-409', '32-G404H' (G = ground floor). Nearly unique per row; combined with building component it identifies the room.

b71bd1aaa8a83ae8.column_purpose: Floor code within the building; numeric floors ('0'-'4'...) plus basement/sub-level codes like 'D6', 'D7', 'G6'. References SPACE_FLOOR lookup for floor names.

e9cc9a656da294ee.column_purpose: ID of the HR organizational unit responsible for/occupying the room; references HR_ORG_UNIT and HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW.

2370b9a234c6b30f.column_purpose: Space accounting unit code (DLC/department space charge code) that owns or occupies the room; references SPACE_UNIT.

c8586a32150d31d9.column_purpose: Space use classification code (abbreviated), e.g. STF ROOM (staff room), RESEARCH CENTER, IT HLPDSK (IT help desk), SLS OFFICE (sales office), FIL RM (file room), RSRC RM (resource room), TRNG RM (training room).
